name: What should I do first if I want custom kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want custom kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Start by defining how the kitchen must work before choosing door styles or finishes. Elite Remodeling & Design can evaluate the existing layout, storage needs, appliance locations, and desired changes as part of a coordinated design and construction plan.

Context: Cabinet decisions affect countertops, lighting, plumbing, electrical work, flooring, and appliance clearances. A beautiful cabinet plan can still disappoint if it creates poor circulation or insufficient landing space.

Key factors:
- Household size and cooking habits
- Existing wall conditions and window locations
- Appliance dimensions and door swings
- Accessibility, trash, pantry, and small-appliance storage

Practical guidance: Gather room measurements, appliance specifications, inspiration photos, and a list of daily frustrations. Ask for a layout review and 3D design visualization before approving cabinet orders.

Elite Remodeling & Design’s design-build process helps connect cabinet choices with the broader kitchen remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with how you use the kitchen, not cabinet colors. Gather measurements, appliance specifications, storage frustrations, and inspiration photos, then have Elite Remodeling & Design review the layout before finalizing cabinet details.
